scope: base-game representative pilot; not full semantic coverage

records.title: Exploration Sequence

sourceAssertions.sourceText: Draw an Exploration card, set up Room/Corridors/markers, move Character, resolve Entrance Effect, discard card. Invalid additional Corridors are omitted.
Close Doors applies only around the new Room; remove-from-game text is outside Entrance Effect.

args.predicate: destination Room slot is empty and Undiscovered

operations.objectRef: random Room of required A/B/C type; use ? if exhausted

operations.notes: Omit a Corridor that would leave the Facility or connect to an already placed Room.

partialResolution.onImpossible: Omit only source-defined invalid Corridors; remove-from-game instruction still resolves when Entrance Effect is ignored

records.title: Move Action and Movement Sequence

sourceAssertions.sourceText: Move costs 1 Action card; choose an adjacent Corridor, resolve opportunity attacks, resolve destination, then make a Noise roll.
Attack prevention during Movement applies to opportunity attacks, not a Hazard-result attack.

args.predicate: Corridor is adjacent to origin Room
path is not blocked by a Closed Door
destination is Discovered Room OR destination is Undiscovered Room slot

operations.subjectRef: Intruders in origin Room and selected Corridor

operations.notes: Occurs after every Movement unless an explicit special effect says otherwise.

partialResolution.onImpossible: Action may be selected only if fully resolvable

records.title: Rest card modifier over Infection Procedure

sourceAssertions.sourceText: Resolve the Infection Procedure. Remove all Uninfected cards from the game.
Scan all Contamination cards in hand; place a Larva if any is Infected and none is present; place Contaminations on top of discard pile.
After resolving an Action card, discard that card.

args.predicate: at least one scanned card is Infected

informationPolicy.secrecy: hidden before scan; post-scan disclosure is not specified by the checked source

operations.objectRef: exact word INFECTED on each scanned card

partialResolution.onImpossible: card may be selected only if fully resolvable

stacking.policy: non-Infected removal replaces normal Infection Procedure discard destination for those cards

sourceVariants.difference: Medical Support source face says non-Infected and “instead of discarding them”; exact punctuation and footer remain separate.
sourceVariants.resolution: pilot encodes only the reviewed canonical source tuple plus the official Procedure; the Medical Support variant is not substituted

records.title: Search Action-card effect

sourceAssertions.sourceText: Draw 1 Item for each Item Icon, keep 1, put the rest on the bottoms of their respective decks, and do not reveal unchosen Items.
For each Item Icon in your Room draw 1 Item of the corresponding type. You may keep 1 of them and discard the rest.
After resolving an Action card, discard that card.

args.predicate: Room has at least 1 Item Icon
the draw/keep/return sequence is fully resolvable

informationPolicy.revealTrigger: chosen Item enters a public area or is used
informationPolicy.secrecy: unchosen Items must not be revealed

operations.objectRef: 1 Item from corresponding deck per Room Item Icon

transition.to: Backpack, Hand slot, or Armor position according to Item class

partialResolution.onImpossible: Action/card effect may be selected only if fully resolvable

stacking.policy: one chosen Item; unchosen returns are independent per deck

sourceVariants.difference: Card says discard the rest; higher-authority rulebook defines discard here as bottom of respective decks and prohibits revealing unchosen Items.
sourceVariants.resolution: official-primary rulebook controls general Search procedure while exact card wording remains preserved

records.title: End-of-game triggers and checks

sourceAssertions.sourceText: Game ends at Round 14, when all players are dead/Escaped/Hibernated, or Facility destruction; then resolve Infection, Eclosion, Objective reveal/check, and winners.
Pending Autodestruction happens before the endgame sequence.

args.predicate: all players died, Escaped, or Hibernated

options: each still-alive eligible Player chooses from their two Objective cards

operations.subjectRef: each alive Escaped/Hibernated Character without Larva
each alive Escaped/Hibernated Character currently with Larva
operations.notes: Whether “currently” includes a Larva gained in S03 is OQ-002.

operations.subjectRef: each still-alive Player lacking chosen Objective

partialResolution.onImpossible: source-specific; unresolved iteration questions remain explicit

outcomes.condition: Character remains alive and chosen Objective is Fulfilled

records.title: Hatching Event resolution

sourceAssertions.sourceText: All Intruders in each NE–SW Corridor move. Place a Larva in the Nest; place 1 Larva in each Unexplored Corridor adjacent to a Character. Resolve each Noise in Unexplored Corridors.
Resolve movement, main effect, secondary effect, then discard; ignore an impossible sentence and continue.

informationPolicy.subjectRef: drawn Event card and all results

operations.notes: If a Character is there, the entry immediately Attacks.

operations.objectRef: 1 Larva in each Unexplored Corridor adjacent to a Character
each existing Noise marker in Unexplored Corridors

partialResolution.onImpossible: ignore only the impossible sentence and continue the card
